title: 'Shoes, Beer Bottles Hurled; Women Pushed Ahead': Injured RAF Officer Reveals How 'Anti-Social' Mob Tried to Break Parliament Security
description: Injured RAF Assistant Commandant Sonia Sehrawat recounted the sequence of violence during the CJP protest at Jantar Mantar, alleging that security personnel were attacked with shoes, slippers and beer bottles, while women were pushed to the front to breach barricades.
